done_criteria.criterion: Qualitative evaluation completed (.lucind/result.json populated with status, summary, and structured findings).

findings.finding: Acceptance verifier loads lane metadata unconditionally and correctly gates mechanical checks on SDDPhase while preserving unconditional scope and result validation.

Integration attempt execution checks in shouldRunAttemptChecks fail closed to running checks on missing metadata, lookup errors, nil ledger, empty sdd_phase, or 'apply' phase across all combined lane branches.

Claude Code and OpenCode skill trees are byte-identical, carrying exact Hard Rule carve-outs, Specialist synthesis note review, and decision-bearing Specialist Acceptance while keeping Promotion forbidden and Tier A Dual-Judge unchanged.
Test coverage in accept_test.go and attempt_test.go executes against real terminal behavior (failing shell scripts causing rejection, check call counts) rather than mocks or tautologies.
Task 4.1 in tasks.md is appropriately left unchecked as out-of-lane-authority since worktrees and lanes cannot write to user dotfiles (~/.claude/skills/sdd-*/SKILL.md).
